div.head: Cn 1020 20
div.ab: Þæt we magan ⁊ moton ealle samod, þurh þæs ecean Godes mildheortnesse ⁊ his halgena þingrædene, to heofena rices myrhðe becuman ⁊ mid him wunian þe leofað ⁊ rihxað a butan ende. Amen.

So that, through the mercy of the eternal God and the intercession of his saints, we may all together have power and permission to attain to the joy of the kingdom of Heaven and to dwell with Him who liveth and reigneth for ever without end. Amen.

so that all together through the mercy of the eternal God and the intercession of his saints we can and may come to the bliss of the heavenly kingdom and dwell with him who liveth and reigneth ever without end. Amen.

damit wir allesammt durch des ewigen Gottes Barmherzigkeit und seiner Heiligen fürbittende Vermittelung zu des Himmelreiches Seligkeit gelangen können und dürfen und bei Ihm wohnen, der lebt und herrscht ewig ohne Ende. Amen.

so that we all together, through the mercy of the eternal God and the intercession of his saints, may and can come to the bliss of the kingdom of heaven and dwell with him who lives and reigns for ever without end. Amen.
